items.title: The Signs Before Eli Lilly Stock Surged Were All On The Record
items.summary: Eli Lilly stock ran on a story that was public and dated long before the price moved, and reading it right still would not have put you ahead of every peer.

items.title: LLY Stock: Collect 12% Now, In Exchange For Capping Upside At 15%
items.summary: Here is a way to get paid a meaningful income now on your Eli Lilly shares, income you keep no matter what the stock does, in exchange for agreeing to sell at a price above today's if it climbs there.

items.title: Here is What to Know Beyond Why Pfizer Inc. (PFE) is a Trending Stock
items.summary: Recently, Zacks.com users have been paying close attention to Pfizer (PFE). This makes it worthwhile to examine what the stock has in store.

items.title: Sanofi to ‘rebuild trust’ with Regeneron; Apnimed adds to string of ‘upsized’ biotech IPOs

items.title: Here Comes the Next Wave of GLP-1s. They’ll Treat a Lot More Than Obesity.

items.title: Bristol Myers Stock Rises. Why the Drugmaker Is Lifting Its Earnings Guidance.
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb faces declining revenue in its legacy drug portfolio, but new products like Opdivo are offsetting the drop.

items.title: Alnylam plunges as earnings deliver ‘one-two punch’
